channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] KFC founder Colonel Sanders' personal items, former home and restaurant up for auction
item.description: KFC founder Colonel Sanders ' pressure cooker, black bow tie and dozens of other personal items are up for public auction Tuesday night.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Teen gets life in prison without parole for killing 4 at Georgia’s Apalachee High School
item.description: A judge on Tuesday sentenced a teenager who killed two students and two teachers in a shooting at Apalachee High School in Georgia to serve life in prison without the possibility of parole.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Majority of toddler foods are ultraprocessed or not meeting nutrition standards
item.description: Four out of five foods sold for toddlers in the United States are ultraprocessed, according to research that analyzed more than 2,700 products on grocery store shelves.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Paddletail Lodge talks about scallop season on Denis Phillips Live
item.description: Scallop season is here and runs through late September. Denis Phillips and his family went out scalloping and had the folks from Paddletail Lodge on DPL to talk about the experience.

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Seattle police say teen arrested in connection with shooting had ghost gun
item.description: The 15-year-old arrested after a shootout at food festival near Seattle's Space Needle over the weekend was armed with a ghost gun with an extended magazine, police said Tuesday.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Drone attacks target gas stations and civilians in Kharkiv, Ukraine
item.description: Ukraine's second-largest city is now within range of Russian drones that cannot be jammed, and war crimes investigators fear the worst.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bride-to-be arrested after allegedly setting fire at LDS church day before wedding
item.description: A 25-year-old bride to be has been arrested in Kaysville after police say she started a fire inside an LDS church the day before her wedding was supposed to take place.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tampa officer fired after Taser use, policy violations: 'You're lucky I didn't beat you up'
item.description: A Tampa police officer was fired following an internal investigation that found he repeatedly violated department policies during a traffic stop earlier this year, according to the Tampa Police Department.

item.description: Wildfires in southwestern France have forced more than 200,000 people to evacuate. The largest blaze near Bordeaux is bigger than Atlanta and has created France's first ever fire cloud.
